name: sabre-fin-stripe
about: A bordered stripe for a FIN (the 4th FIW Sabres' second band, parallel to the rudder line): 1.0 wide along X, 4.5 tall along Y — finite, so a flat placement (sides: both) stays on the fin; rotate the frame to follow the sweep. '@' = the stripe colour, yellow by default; dark-blue borders.
